title: Titanium Tip by Dynavap
description:
DynaVap’s Titanium Tip features a three level adjustable depth herb chamber, five fin cooling system and
3 helical heat exchange channels for better air flow and vapour production.
There are three Adjust-A-Bowl levels to choose from depending on how much herb you want to use at once. Adjustments are done by pushing the titanium CCD (screen) into one of three grooves found inside the herb chamber.
The titanium tip is compatible with all DynaVap midsections including the “M”.
Included
1 x Titanium Tip (screen included)
